sections.title: Listen and circle. 听一听，圈出听到的图片
Look and match. 看图，把教室物品和单词连起来
Read and choose. 读一读，选出最合适的句子
sections.answers: 1 Let me clean the blackboard. 2 Who's on duty? 3 Thank you. 4 Put the books back.

sections.title: Look and choose. 看图，圈出正确的表达
Speak and act. 说一说，演一演（家长/老师评分）
sections.answers: 任选两句，符合情境且能清楚表达即可：发音清楚8分，表达合适8分，大胆开口4分。

sections.title: Listen and number. 听一听，给图片标上1-4
sections.answers: 课桌图1；黑板图2；放书图3；地面图4。

sections.title: Choose and fill. 选择合适的单词填空
sections.answers: 1 classroom 2 chair 3 blackboard 4 floor（We learn in the classroom. / We sit on a chair. / We write on the blackboard. / We walk on the floor.）

sections.title: Complete the dialogue. 选择句子补全对话
Think and choose. 想一想，选择合适的做法或表达
sections.answers: 1A Let me clean the floor. 2A Thank you. 3A Clean the blackboard. 4A Put the books back.

sections.title: Mini-project. 我的值日任务
sections.answers: 任选两项；句型完整、发音基本清楚即可。

usageNotes: 每题听力读两遍。"位置"（on / under / beside）仅作观察拓展，不列为本单元核心考核点。
